sections.content: Longer periods that include now also go with the *pretérito perfecto*: *esta semana*, *este fin de semana*, *este mes* and *este año*. You know *semana*, *fin de semana* and *mes* from A1; *año* (year) is new here. The period is not over yet, so you say what you have done in it with *haber* + past participle.

items.spanish: Esta semana hemos comprado los boletos.
items.english: This week we have bought the tickets.

items.spanish: Este fin de semana hemos visitado el río.
items.english: This weekend we have visited the river.

items.spanish: Este mes Daniela ha escrito muchos mensajes.
items.english: This month Daniela has written many messages.

items.spanish: Este año Carlos ha viajado mucho.
items.english: This year Carlos has travelled a lot.

sections.content: You know *este* and *esta* from A1: *este* goes with *mes*, *año* and *fin de semana*, *esta* goes with *semana*, *mañana* and *tarde*.
